userDirection: One reusable general agent per environment participates across rooms; reuse native multi-thread app-server instead of one full server per agent/room.
constraints: No new message relay or model polling; reuse native WebSocket-over-private-Unix transport and canonical Hollywood membership.
Keep agent/thread identity and callback ownership distinct; do not merge unrelated contexts or silently change profiles/models/permissions.
One approved host profile per shared server; do not merge separate accounts or protected legacy Work channels.
Shared-client disconnect/cancel cannot terminate host server or another thread; no private-process fallback on connection failure.
Current215 workers,159 release and active audits preserved until exact qualified migration with original transcripts/receipts.
Host room participation is explicit permission policy, not a role-name side effect; grant before first human input fanout and respect later revocation.
Initial native deployment scope is enrolled CPU and GPU; do not claim system76/Mac/BLD enrollment without actual local evidence.
